specimen_class.payload_note: Byte payloads are plain text; canonical text blocks are normalizer-produced JSON.
establishes: inherited_from.receipt_id selects the cited receipt manifest and origin_identity binds the member address in that manifest: native_mid, block index, and source ordinal.
predecessor_identity independently names the source block and must match between the held and successor members.
source.sha256 is computed in mc.d5.block.source.v1 and served.sha256 is computed in mc.d5.block.served.v1 over their explicit byte payloads.
UnitRecordV1.sha256 is computed in mc.d5.unit-projection.v1 over unit, row_version, and the explicit projection bytes; served and unit-projection digests bind through bytes and are never compared.
Constructed carrier metadata makes reduction and compartment unit locator resolution representable against a returned-message shape.
Present reduced members locate committed units at their own native_mid and block index; absent reduced members may use independently located validated units.
does_not_establish: locator resolution against a real returned view
specimen_class.follow_up: Exercise canonical normalized provider-block bytes and constructed locator carriers through the real normalizer and returned-view path.
specimen_class.presence_note: Every member_presence value and carrier is a CONSTRUCTED input. These algebra vectors make locator resolution representable but do not claim observed presence in a real returned array.

predicate_rule.unit_validation_order: Clause 21a: validate UnitRecordV1 from returned bytes at its locator and derive VALIDATED(this pass) before evaluating any member transfer proof.
predicate_rule.member_join: R46f: successor provenance must be inherited_from with receipt_id equal to the held receipt and origin_identity equal to the held M1 member address inside that receipt's manifest (native_mid, block index, source ordinal); predecessor_identity independently names the source block and must match.
may_change: tool_links use_identity and result_identity re-anchor while tool_use_id and arc membership remain fixed
served only through a current-pass validated applied_unit
applied_unit None to Some or Some(u1) to Some(u2) with current-pass validation
forbidden: unit claim absent from VALIDATED(this pass)
predicate_rule.digest_domains: R46e(i): served.sha256 is H(mc.d5.block.served.v1, B); UnitRecordV1.sha256 is H(mc.d5.unit-projection.v1, {unit,row_version,B}); binding is through B and the digests are never compared.
predicate_rule.refusal_transport: Any failed inherited-member transfer predicate is HTTP 503 with error.code d5_carry_proof_mismatch.
predicate_rule.expectations: Expected outcomes are owner-authored fixture data; the Rust oracle evaluates the predicate independently and compares its verdict to these literals.
predicate_rule.unit_locator_rule: Clause 21a: a present reduced member locates its committed unit at its own native_mid and block index; an absent reduced member may cite an independently located validated unit; a compartment carrier never names a manifest member.

twice_inherited_ordinal_resolution.decision: M2 ordinal and predecessor_identity continue to name P source space; they do not rebase onto S. Only T serving native_mid and native_position are freshly allocated.
citations: R24a: Ordinal is a SOURCE coordinate used by coverage, F, tags, and predecessor_identity; predecessor_identity names the source block.
R46e(i): ordinal and predecessor_identity are added to the MUST-match set between held M1 and inherited M2; only native_mid and native_position may change.
Contract clause 5: native_mid is positional and distinct from block index; the manifest maps it to predecessor_identity used by A and tags, while serving uses native_mid.

vectors.name: frozen member preserves P source coordinates across P to S to T
re-reduction validates the successor unit this pass
reduced member cannot resurrect to source
prior unit record cannot substitute for current-pass validation
identity-only comparison must reject changed source digest
frozen member cannot change served bytes
origin identity cannot reuse the P source identity
predecessor identity cannot reuse the S serving identity
fresh serving MID at each inheritance preserves the independent source identity

generation.digest_values: Derived from explicit bytes and exact CE1 preimages; the generator reproduces every source, served, and unit-projection digest.

unit_locator_controls.name: present reduced member owns its committed unit location
present reduced member refuses a distinct committed unit location

carrier.carrier_note: Constructed INDEPENDENT-SOURCE carrier with its own ordinal 61, so the ONLY defect in this control is the one under test: a PRESENT member whose committed unit sits somewhere other than its own location. Leaving the member's ordinal here would have added a second, unrelated invalidity.

unit_locator_controls.name: absent reduced member accepts an independently located validated unit

carrier.carrier_note: Constructed INDEPENDENT-SOURCE carrier: a different source message from the absent member, so it holds its own ordinal 53. A different serving mid alone would NOT imply a different source (R24a/V10 permit mid reallocation with the source ordinal unchanged); the independence is declared here, never inferred from mid inequality.

unit_locator_controls.name: compartment unit resolves in a synthetic m0 carrier
compartment unit refuses a locator naming a manifest member
absent reduced member accepts a reallocated serving mid that keeps its source ordinal

carrier.carrier_note: Constructed SAME-SOURCE carrier under a reallocated serving mid (R24a/V10): the mid differs from the member's while the source ordinal 54 is unchanged, because a serving identity is allocated per hop and an ordinal is a source coordinate. This control exists so no rule may read unequal mid as implying unequal source.
